correctness.rationale: The finite chain is lumpable by the positive count; direct combinatorial enumeration yields positive a_k and nonnegative b_k with b_(N-1)=0. The absorbing-chain harmonic recurrence determines exact finite fixation. At p=1/2 the ratio products are birthday survival probabilities. Uniform log expansions on O(sqrt N) and a valid global Gaussian envelope give the error-function limit and one-seed constants. The standalone verification script independently solved finite Dirichlet problems by exact rational arithmetic and passed 336 checks. Only mathematical proof, not finite tests, supports infinite limits.

value.rationale: The exact critical p=1/2 boundary is a natural phase transition in the motivating nonlinear media-voter paper. The finite birthday representation is an unexpected probabilistic structural equivalence, and the parameter-coupled Gaussian profile quantifies takeover for sparse initial seeds at the deterministic-to-stochastic boundary. These exact scale and amplitude laws can benchmark simulation and clarify the failure of deterministic positive-density intuition for o(sqrt N) seeds; they are not a routine relabeling or arbitrary parameter slice.
